description: This file contains unit tests for HAL interface implementations in the Android platform, specifically testing AIDL and HIDL interface registration, presence, and compliance within the Cuttlefish environment. It includes tests to verify that all AIDL interfaces are declared in the manifest, that no extensions are improperly present on AOSP interfaces, and that known missing interfaces are correctly identified.

classes.name: VersionedAidlPackage
classes.description: Represents an AIDL package with versioning information used for manifest and registration checks.

classes.name: AidlPackageCheck
classes.description: Holds registration and missing status for a specific AIDL package version during tests.

methods.name: getAidlPackage
methods.description: Extracts the package name from a fully qualified AIDL type string.

methods.name: isAospAidlInterface
methods.description: Determines if an interface name belongs to the Android Open Source Project's AIDL interfaces.

methods.name: getDeviceType
methods.description: Detects the device type (Automotive, TV, Watch, Phone) based on system features.

methods.name: isMissingAidl
methods.description: Checks if a given package name is considered missing in the current environment based on device type.

methods.name: allAidlManifestInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves all AIDL interfaces declared in the device and framework manifests.
